title: Randomization Tests in Switchback Experiments
abstract: arXiv:2602.23257v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Switchback experiments assign an experimental unit, such as a market or a platform, to treatment or control over successive blocks of time. Inference can be challenging because these experiments often contain only a small number of randomized blocks, while outcomes may exhibit serial dependence, seasonality, and treatment effects that persist across periods. We develop a conditional randomization test for the null of no total treatment effect that is finite-sample valid under standard assumptions on temporal interference without requiring a parametric model for outcomes. We also develop randomization tests for these assumptions: a carryover test that assesses whether past assignments continue to affect outcomes beyond a prespecified horizon and a non-anticipation test that assesses whether future assignments affect current outcomes. translated_title: 转换实验中的随机化检验
translated_abstract: 转换实验在连续的时间块上将实验单位（如市场或平台）分配到处理组或对照组。由于这类实验通常只包含少量随机化的时间块，而结果变量可能表现出序列相关、季节性以及跨期持续的处理效应，统计推断因此具有挑战性。我们开发了一种针对“无总体处理效应”原假设的条件随机化检验，该检验在对时间干扰的标准假设下具有有限样本有效性，且无需对结果变量设定参数模型。我们还开发了针对这些假设本身的随机化检验：一种是延续效应检验，用于评估过去的分配是否在预定期限之外继续影响结果；另一种是非预期检验，用于评估未来的分配是否影响当前的结果。对于关于平均处理效应的假设，我们建立了学生化统计量的渐近有效性。
tldr: 本文针对转换实验提出了有限样本有效的条件随机化检验，无需参数模型即可处理时间干扰问题，并创新性地发展了用于检验延续效应和非预期假设的随机化检验方法。
en_tdlr: This paper develops finite-sample valid conditional randomization tests for switchback experiments that handle temporal interference without parametric models, and introduces randomization tests for carryover and non-anticipation assumptions.
